modules.title: 页面的标题层级：点一段看它是什么标签
标题层级为什么有顺序

items.title: H1 的数量要看页面内容
items.text: HTML 允许多个 H1；检查每个 H1 是否标记一组独立的主要内容，不要只按数量决定删改。

items.title: 层级按顺序递进
items.text: H1→H2→H3 可表达逐层从属；不必要地跳过层级会让大纲更难理解，但它本身不是 HTML 语法错误。

items.title: 机器和人都读它
items.text: 屏幕阅读器可按标题浏览内容；字号大小只影响外观，不能代替标题结构。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: “字号最大”不等于“层级最高”：标题标签表达结构，视觉大小是样式。H1 可以有多个；重点是标题能否准确组织页面内容。

lessonPractice.title: 一个页面出现两个 H1，应该马上删掉一个吗？

options.label: 不能只凭数量判错；检查它们代表的内容和标题层级是否清楚
options.feedback: 对。HTML 允许多个 H1；应检查它们是否对应页面中各自的主要内容，并让后续标题体现清楚的从属关系。

options.label: 只要字号大小看起来对，用哪个标签都行
options.feedback: 标签决定结构语义；字号只是外观，机器按标签读大纲。

options.label: 把 H1 用在字号最大的任何文字上
options.feedback: H1 是页面主标题的角色标记，不是“最大字号”的样式开关。

en.title: A page has two H1s. Should one be removed right away?

options.label: Do not judge by the count alone; check that the headings and their levels express a clear outline
options.feedback: Correct. HTML allows multiple H1s; check whether each marks its own main content and whether later headings show their nesting clearly.

options.label: As long as font sizes look right, any tag works
options.feedback: Tags carry structural meaning; font size only changes appearance. Assistive technology can navigate through heading tags.

options.label: Use H1 on whatever text has the largest font size
options.feedback: H1 marks the role of the page's main heading; it is not a style switch for the biggest font.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请按页面内容检查标题结构。不要仅凭多个 H1 就判错；确认各级标题能表达清楚的从属关系，再用大纲视图核对结构，并告诉我每个标题对应哪一节。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Review this page's heading structure against its content. Do not treat multiple H1s as an error by themselves; make sure each heading level shows a clear parent-child relationship. Then use an outline view to confirm the structure and tell me which sections each heading introduces.

learning.assumes: You have seen page outlines or SEO check messages, or heard of heading levels.
learning.outcome: You can check whether heading tags reflect the page content hierarchy, including whether multiple H1s make sense.

modules.title: A page's heading levels: click a section to see its tag
Why heading levels have an order

items.title: Use H1 according to the content
items.text: HTML allows multiple H1s; check whether each marks a distinct main section instead of deleting one just because of the count.

items.title: Levels descend in order
items.text: H1→H2→H3 can express nested sections; skipping a level unnecessarily can make the outline harder to follow, but is not an HTML syntax error by itself.

items.title: Machines and people read it
items.text: Screen readers can navigate by headings; font size only affects appearance and cannot replace heading structure.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: Biggest font size does not mean highest level: heading tags express structure, visual size is styling. Multiple H1s are allowed; the headings should still organize the page clearly.

distinctions.label: Visual hierarchy
distinctions.text: Visual hierarchy expresses importance through font size and only looks big; heading levels mark structure with tags and are machine-readable.

distinctions.label: Page title tag
distinctions.text: The page title only sets the text shown on the browser tab; the H1 is the main heading in the page body—different positions.
